description.value: Full-service RV resort on Osoyoos Lake with a private sandy beach, lake views, flush washrooms, and year-round operation; tent camping is explicitly not permitted, making this a skip for most touring cyclists unless arriving by RV or renting an on-site unit.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an RV park/resort in Osoyoos on Lakeshore Drive, with address and phone matching the footer and contact page. Showers are confirmed as 'coin operated' in two washroom/shower houses. Laundry is confirmed year-round with coin-operated washers and dryers. The site mentions restaurants and downtown Osoyoos less than 5 minutes away, supporting food nearby. Reservations are accepted via an online request form. However, the site is entirely RV-focused with no mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodation, which is a concern for cycling tourists without an RV.
concerns: No tent or hiker/biker sites mentioned; all content is RV-focused
On-site store has been permanently discontinued
